sources.title: From Gemma 3 270M to FunctionGemma, How Google AI Built a Compact ...
sources.snippet: Google has released FunctionGemma, a specialized version of the Gemma 3 270M model that is trained specifically for function calling and designed to run as an edge agent that maps natural language to executable API actions. But, What is FunctionGemma? FunctionGemma is a 270M parameter text only transformer based on Gemma 3 270M.
